Exercise: Band Assisted Pull-Up

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
None

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- horizontal_pulling

Primary Muscles:

- lats

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- forearms
- middle back

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improve_latissimus_dorsi_activation
- enhance_grip_strength_and_forearm_endurance
- develop_upper_body_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder impingement
- Severe wrist or elbow injuries

Exercise Variations:

- name: Band Assisted Chin-Up, primaryMuscles: ['lats', 'biceps']
- name: Wide-Grip Band Assisted Pull-Up, primaryMuscles: ['lats', 'middle back']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine, equipment: machine
- exercise_name: Bodyweight Pull-Up, equipment: bar

Instructions:

- Choke the band around the center of the pullup bar. You can use different bands to provide varying levels of assistance.
- Pull the end of the band down, and place one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to wide grip on the bar. This will be your starting position.
- Pull yourself upward by contracting the lats as you flex the elbow. The elbow should be driven to your side. Pull to the front, attempting to get your chin over the bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements.
- After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
